response.sql: SELECT link_to_major AS major_id, COUNT(*) AS member_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member) AS fraction FROM member GROUP BY link_to_major ORDER BY fraction DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Members with NULL link_to_major form a single group, which GROUP BY produces naturally. Its major_id is shown as NULL. The total is the count of all rows in member.
Ties in fraction are broken arbitrarily, because the request gives no tie-break rule.
